items.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
items.title_zh: GPT-5.4 mini 与 nano 正式发布
items.summary: GPT-5.4 mini and nano are smaller, faster versions of GPT-5.4 optimized for coding, tool use, multimodal reasoning, and high-volume API and sub-agent workloads.

items.title: Chronos: Temporal-Aware Conversational Agents with Structured Event Retrieval for Long-Term Memory
items.title_zh: Chronos：面向长期记忆、具备结构化事件检索的时间感知对话智能体
items.summary: Chronos decomposes dialogue into subject-verb-object event tuples with resolved datetime ranges and entity aliases, indexing them in an event calendar alongside a turn calendar that preserves conversational context. With dynamic query-time retrieval guidance and an iterative tool-calling loop, it reaches 92.60% (Low) and 95.60% (High) on the 500-question LongMemEvalS benchmark, a 7.67% improvement over the best prior system.

items.title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild
items.title_zh: MetaClaw：在真实环境中元学习并持续进化的智能体
items.summary: MetaClaw is a continual meta-learning framework that evolves a base LLM policy together with a library of reusable skills, combining LLM-synthesized skills for zero-downtime adaptation with scheduled LoRA and reinforcement-learning updates. In the authors' experiments it lifts Kimi-K2.5 accuracy from 21.4% to 40.6%.

items.title: OpenResearcher: A Fully Open Pipeline for Long-Horizon Deep Research Trajectory Synthesis
items.title_zh: OpenResearcher：面向长时程深度研究轨迹合成的全开放流水线
items.summary: OpenResearcher is a reproducible pipeline that decouples one-time corpus bootstrapping from multi-turn trajectory synthesis and runs the search-and-browse loop fully offline over a 15M-document corpus using search, open and find primitives. With GPT-OSS-120B as teacher it synthesizes over 97K trajectories, and supervised fine-tuning a 30B-A3B backbone reaches 54.8% on BrowseComp-Plus, a 34-point gain over the base model.

items.title: HierarchicalKV: A GPU Hash Table with Cache Semantics for Continuous Online Embedding Storage
items.title_zh: HierarchicalKV：面向持续在线嵌入存储的带缓存语义 GPU 哈希表
items.summary: HierarchicalKV is a general-purpose GPU hash table library with cache semantics, resolving full-bucket upserts in place through eviction or admission rejection rather than rehashing or capacity failure. On an NVIDIA H100 NVL it reports up to 3.9 billion key-value pairs per second find throughput, stable across load factors 0.50-1.00, and 1.4x higher find throughput than WarpCore.

items.title: Structural Abstraction as an Inductive Bias for Non-Stationary Language Model Training
items.title_zh: 结构抽象作为非平稳语言模型训练的归纳偏置
items.summary: Abstraction-Augmented Training is a loss-level modification that jointly optimizes over concrete instances and their structural abstractions, introduced alongside the Relational Cycle Benchmark and Narrative Abstraction Benchmark. The authors report that it consistently reduces forgetting and improves relational generalization in non-stationary training, in a pattern aligned with cognitive predictions for schema-based learning.

items.title: Efficient Reasoning on the Edge
items.title_zh: 边缘设备上的高效推理
items.summary: The work enables reasoning in small LLMs with LoRA adapters and supervised fine-tuning, adds budget forcing via reinforcement learning to cut response length with minimal accuracy loss, and exploits parallel test-time scaling for memory-bound decoding. It also presents dynamic adapter switching and KV-cache sharing, evaluated on Qwen2.5-7B for on-device use.

items.title: ssrajadh/sentrysearch
items.summary: sentrysearch is a Python project for semantic search over videos using Gemini Embedding 2 or Qwen3-VL.
